_comment: Recorded perf baselines (PERF §5). Each entry: the pinned number, the release that measured it, and what regression looks like. Ratio tests multiply by --perf-tolerance (default 1.25).

conftest_snapshot.note: T-9: conftest._BASELINE_MODS snapshot size. Growth past the budget means the per-test _restore() cost is drifting up — trim module state or split a module before adding more. Re-measured at 0.89.0 (turn split into turn_footer/tool_prefetch/argsalvage/turn_retry; 81 -> 85). Budget raised 86 -> 95 with ledger justification: the 0.88.x/0.89.0 monolith decomposition (memory, compress, subagent, dispatch, turn) trades one _restore() scan over 5 fat module dicts for 17 small ones — same total entries (3541 vs 3023 at 0.68.0), +17% over five minor releases, and it is the direction the repo's stated convention (nx/_feature.py per concern) requires.

active_tools_floor.note: The non-gated schema count sent every turn. A new always-on tool must displace one into tier-2 or justify the rise in the test_initial_context ledger (feature-cost rule, PERF §6).
